title: Zenvora incorporated in Hyderabad
details: Arvind Kulkarni and Meera Subramanian leave Kestrel Networks and start Zenvora from a rented room in Madhapur.

title: Pulse 1.0 launches
details: First release: shared inbox for email and SMS, with six pilot customers.

title: Seed round of INR 2.5 crore
details: Led by Godavari Angels Network.

title: First Head of People & Culture joins
details: Lakshmi Prasanna Varma builds Zenvora's HR function.

title: WhatsApp Business channel added to Pulse
details: Becomes the most-used channel within a year.

title: Bengaluru Engineering Hub opens
details: Opened to hire senior backend, ML and SRE engineers.

title: Zenvora Care launches
details: Managed customer care using Pulse as the work tool. First client brand is Swift Courier.

title: Data & AI team formed
details: Ananya Bhattacharya joins to start the function.

title: Zenvora Ledger general availability
details: Invoicing and reconciliation for small businesses.

title: Company moves to fully remote work
details: Response to the COVID-19 lockdown; Care Centre staff work in split shifts with transport support.

title: Visakhapatnam Care Centre opens
details: Zenvora Care operations move from Hyderabad to Visakhapatnam.

title: Series A of INR 18 crore
details: Led by Deccan Capital Partners.

title: Hybrid Work Policy introduced
details: Three days in office per week replaces the fully remote model.

title: Project Atlas starts
details: Monolith to microservices migration.

title: Austin sales presence established
details: Ashwin Pillai joins as Business Development Manager, US.

title: ZenPeople HRMS goes live (Project Compass)
details: Attendance, leave, payroll and expenses in one system.

title: Pulse named SME Tech Product of the Year
details: Awarded at the Southern India SaaS Summit 2023.

title: Monolith decommissioned (Project Atlas complete)
details: Deploy time down from 3 days to 40 minutes.

title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certificate issued
details: Result of Project Sentinel.

title: Project Beacon hands over to run team
details: Data platform in production.

title: Project Horizon complete
details: Care Centre expands to 45 seats and four new brands.

title: SOC 2 Type II report issued
details: Project Sentinel closes.

title: Project Ember closes
details: Cloud spend down 31 percent.

title: Zenvora Sage beta starts
details: AI assistant for Tier-1 support replies.

title: Pulse Mobile 3.0 fully rolled out
details: Project Lighthouse complete.

title: Project Nova starts
details: Churn-risk scoring and Pulse Insights.

title: Tarun Mehta resigns
details: UI Designer serves a 60-day notice period; last working day 2026-11-14.

title: H1 FY2026-27 appraisal window opens
details: Self-reviews due 2026-10-16; manager reviews due 2026-10-30.
